digest.component_or_area: autodeploy script and review-bot lifecycle management
propositions: autodeploy.sh recreates the review-bot container without waiting for in-flight reviews to complete, killing the code review mid-execution and preventing the LLM-Review gate from receiving votes during landing bursts

the reconcile_loop awaits review_and_vote inline outside the webhook queue, so it is cancelled within 10 seconds during shutdown rather than protected by the 1200+ second drain period, making retries the unprotected path that perpetuates the live-lock
the live-lock is invisible to monitoring because a killed review process emits no VOTER_ERROR, leaving all health signals green while the gate is fully stalled and unsubmittable

during a landing burst with deploy gaps shorter than the ~10 minute review duration, repeated recreations prevent reviews from completing and the self-heal reconciler cannot converge, creating a gate stall dependent only on the burst ending, not on any deploy-side bound

the deferral strategy waits for in-flight reviews to idle before recreating, bounded by 1800 seconds keyed to the deferral episode rather than the target SHA so the bound cannot be reset during a burst, and emits countable tokens (AUTODEPLOY_DEFERRED, AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT) for observability
